title: Add a new patient
note: PLAN: the plan asks for caregivers L1–L3, but a care circle holds at most 2 by design (lib/types.ts:6 MAX_CAREGIVERS = 2; app/api/patients/route.ts:21). Sending 3 gave HTTP 400 "A care circle has at most 2 caregivers (primary and backup)". With 2 caregivers everything else passed: patient created with all fields, caregivers saved as levels 1–2, listed in Patients, PATIENT_ONBOARDED audited.
